notes: Date column and day layout: date.monitoringnight (noon to noon, black line at 00:00) or date.calendar (midnight to midnight, black line at 12:00). A plotframe's $date is used when it has no column of this name.
Column holding each record's time of day (only the time is read).
Height of each time bin, e.g. 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour. Must divide evenly into 24 hours.
discrete = one colour per count bin (all bins always in the legend); continuous = colour gradient from the lowest to the highest bin.values.
Semicolon-separated upper limit of each count bin (discrete: 0, 1, 2-10, 11-25, 26-50, 51+) or the scale's tick values (continuous: bottom = first, top = last).

Semicolon-separated colours (discrete: one more than bin.values) or ONE palette name: viridis (magma), scico (batlow), RColorBrewer (YlOrRd), Okabe-Ito or colorspace (Heat). Use pkg::name to be exact (colorspace reuses many names) and a leading - to reverse (-magma).
